subject: Mutual Action Plan: capacity runway & MAP orchestration for Dedicated/Private
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Jordan <alex@novacorp.com>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya@novacorp.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: MAP kickoff: Dedicated / Private capacity planning

Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for the time today. Per our conversation, I’m putting the first-draft mutual action plan together focused on two items you flagged: (1) evaluation gating for Dedicated vs Private, and (2) lead times / GPU pool sizing needed to guarantee your throughput targets.

High-level ask from our side: can you confirm the target QPS and token-per-day footprint for the models you plan to run in production (sample rows in the attached capacity_profile.pdf)? If you can give a 3-month ramp profile (pilot -> 1st release -> scale), we’ll map to GPU tranche options and lead times (H100 availability vs L7 alternatives).

Immediate next steps I propose: 
- Novacorp shares current QPS + expected percent growth by week for the 12-week ramp (attachment: capacity_profile.pdf)
- Redwood provides MAP_v1.xlsx with milestones: eval acceptance, SOC2 docs, procurement commit window, and SLA targets
- We align on a provisioning contingency: canary pool (1–2 nodes) for early traffic, plus staged tranche delivery for production.

I’ve attached a light MAP template (MAP_v1.xlsx) and a capacity profile sample to accelerate. I’ll loop in Rishi for procurement/discount engineering and Marissa for onboarding milestones.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)]
[Attachment: capacity_profile.pdf (pdf)]

From: Alex Jordan <alex@novacorp.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya@novacorp.com>, Tim Chen <tim.chen@novacorp.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: Dedicated / Private capacity planning

Vanessa —

Thanks — this is exactly what we need to make progress. A few clarifications from our side:

1) Workload and targets: Pilot will run a trimmed NLU workflow at ~40 qps (peak) and ~3M tokens/day. Production target after scale is ~400 qps and ~30–35M tokens/day. We expect ~8–10x traffic increase over 8 weeks post-launch.

2) Security gating: SOC2 attestation + infrastructure network diagrams are mandatory for our procurement team prior to PO.

3) Procurement window: our finance can sign on a 12–14 week lead time from contract signature to hardware in region. If Redwood can offer a staged delivery (12-week + 4-week tranche), we can accept split billing.

4) Acceptance criteria: we need an eval pass demonstrating 95th percentile latency <= 250ms for the primary model at 75% of production QPS.

We’ll run the initial eval during the week of July 12 — I’ll confirm exact days once internal calendars are cleared. Can you confirm you can map the above to a concrete tranche plan and associated acceptance gates?

—Alex
Head of ML Platform, Novacorp
[no attachments]

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Jordan <alex@novacorp.com>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya@novacorp.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Tim Chen <tim.chen@novacorp.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: Dedicated / Private capacity planning

Alex / Team —

Appreciate the clear targets — that helps a lot. Attached is MAP_v1.xlsx with a tranche-based recommendation (Pilot tranche: 2x H100-like nodes for canary; Tranche A: 8x H100-equivalents for 75% of expected production; Tranche B: top-up to reach 100%). Key callouts:

- Lead times: H100-class hardware in our US region is currently showing 10–12 week procurement lead time; alternative L7/90-class GPUs can be provisioned in 4–6 weeks as an interim lane.
- Acceptance gating: we propose an evaluation window (3 days) staged at 25%, 50%, 75% of target qps with latency load tests and KV-cache warmup. The eval script and pass/fail matrix are in the MAP spreadsheet.
- Compliance: attaching a SOC2 evidence summary we can share with your procurement team immediately. Full artifact package requires an NDA-addendum (we can provision a redacted package now).
- Pricing & procurement: Rishi — can you confirm if we can offer a staggered billing option (50% on Tranche A commit, remainder on Tranche B delivery) and whether a short pilot credit (one week) is available for the canary pool?

Next steps I’ll own: finalize MAP_v1 with dates for the eval window (proposed July 12–16), ship SOC2 redacted evidence now, and draft a tranche billing term for procurement to review.

Vanessa
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SOC2_evidence_summary.pdf]
[Attachment: MAP_v1.xlsx (updated)]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 26 Jun 2027 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: capacity runway & MAP orchestration for Dedicated/Private

Team —

Quick procurement note: we can support split billing for this deal. Proposed commercial terms: 12-month reserved commitment with a staged invoice schedule tied to tranche delivery dates. We can also extend a one-week pilot credit for the canary pool (technical validation only).

However, two operational risks to flag for the MAP:
1) H100 supply volatility: if procurement slips beyond 12 weeks, we need a defined fallback to L7-equivalent with a documented QoS delta and optional post-delivery re-quantization migration plan.
2) Acceptance re-runs: if Novacorp requests additional acceptance tests beyond the 3-day window, we should price re-runs or lock them to one complimentary rerun.

Marissa — please prepare an onboarding milestone table (handover checklist, SSO setup, cust. entitlements) and a short runbook for the canary cutover. I’ll draft the commercial clause language for staged invoices and the contingency section for hardware lead-time.

-Rishi
Head of Commercial Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
[no attachments]

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Jordan <alex@novacorp.com>, Priya Sharma <priya@novacorp.com>, Tim Chen <tim.chen@novacorp.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Final MAP & next steps (DocuSign + eval schedule)

Alex / Priya / Tim —

Thanks for the alignment. Attached and linked above are the final MAP artifacts: MAP_v1.xlsx (final), capacity_profile.pdf, SOC2_evidence_summary.pdf, and a DocuSign envelope for the tranche MSA (link included). Summary of key dates and asks:

- Eval window: July 12–16 (we’ll provision a canary pool on July 9 for early checks)
- Tranche A commit (billing milestone): sign by July 30 to hit 12-week delivery cadence for core capacity in region
- Fallback lane: L7-equivalent delivery in 4–6 weeks if H100-class slips; we’ll document performance delta in the MAP and provide a migration window post-delivery
- Acceptance criteria: as discussed — 95th pctl latency <= 250ms at 75% target QPS over a 3-day run

Action items for Novacorp:
1) Approve the MAP spreadsheet and mark acceptance cells in the sheet
2) Share finance procurement lead and PO contact so Rishi can coordinate staged invoice terms
3) Confirm eval participants and preferred days for July 12–16

We’ll keep this thread as the canonical MAP thread. If agreed, I’ll send the DocuSign envelope for signature and schedule the eval kickoff.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
